title: Neko photo grid
description: An asymmetric grid of three rounded photos with small white capitalised labels in their corners (a wide one, a tall one and a square one tucked under), and a compact serif heading, paragraph and arrow link in the free corner. Opens with a divider row. On phones two small photos sit side by side, offset, over a big square. The labels fade in as the photos scroll into view.
notes: exactly three photo slots (wide, tall, square); empty they are slate placeholders so the white labels read
labels are background-coloured (white on the neko theme); keep photos darkish at the top-left
name: neko-photo-grid
